name: RGBXY Derivatives with Optimal Transport (DROT)
definition: A differentiable rendering method that associates each screen-space pixel with a visible 3D geometric point (point proxy) and computes 5D RGBXY derivatives on these proxies to measure how 3D RGB color and 2D projected screen-space position change with respect to scene parameters, combined with an optimal transport based loss function for pixel matching.
summary: DROT is a differentiable rendering method that uses 5D RGBXY derivatives and optimal transport to solve convergence issues in inverse rendering for distant object matches.
